key.name: dictation-shortcut
key.description: Hold it to dictate; tap it to toggle hands-free dictation.

key.name: enabled
key.description: Enable or disable the shortcut.

key.name: mode
key.description: auto: hold the modifier to dictate, tap to toggle. hold: release always stops. toggle: the shortcut starts and stops.

key.name: tap-ms
key.description: Releasing the modifier within this many milliseconds counts as a tap (toggle mode).

key.name: silence-stop-s
key.description: In hands-free mode, stop after this many seconds of silence. 0 = never.

key.name: microphone
key.description: PipeWire node name of the microphone to record from. Empty = the system default input.

key.name: tidy
key.description: Drop hesitations (euh, uh, hum) and words said twice in a row from the dictated text. Instant, by rules.

key.name: corrections
key.description: "at 2, no, I mean 3" becomes "at 3", by rules, in French and English.

key.name: vocabulary
key.description: Names, brands and jargon written your way; words that sound alike are corrected after recognition.

key.name: replacements
key.description: A spoken phrase and the text written in its place.

key.name: text-mode-email
key.description: as-said: the words as they come. message, email, notes, custom: the whole text is rewritten by a language model at the end of the dictation.

key.name: text-mode-chat
key.description: as-said: the words as they come. message, email, notes, custom: the whole text is rewritten by a language model at the end of the dictation.

key.name: text-mode-code
key.summary: Mode for code editors and terminals
key.description: as-said: the words as they come. message, email, notes, custom: the whole text is rewritten by a language model at the end of the dictation.

key.name: text-mode-other
key.description: as-said: the words as they come. message, email, notes, custom: the whole text is rewritten by a language model at the end of the dictation.

key.name: text-mode-custom
key.description: The instruction of the "custom" mode, given to the language model with the dictated text.

key.name: history-days
key.description: Days the text of past dictations is kept on this computer. 0: not kept. -1: until cleared.

key.name: polish
key.description: Send each finished block through the local LLM (llama.cpp, installed with the voice commands) to keep only the corrected version when the speaker corrects themselves ("Monday, no, Tuesday"). Slow (seconds per block) and approximate; the text is kept as it is when the answer does not look like a clean-up.

key.name: cloud-enabled
key.description: Off: everything stays on this computer. On: the text of a request may be sent to the chosen provider, with the API key stored in the GNOME keyring. Speech is always recognised locally.

key.name: cloud-provider
key.description: Which provider's model is used when cloud-enabled is on.

key.name: cloud-model
key.description: Model of the chosen provider used by the voice commands when cloud-enabled is on.

key.name: keep-loaded-min
key.description: Minutes the speech model (about 1 GB) stays in memory after the last dictation. The next dictation after that waits a few seconds for it to load.

key.name: welcome-shown
key.description: Whether the first-run check for the speech engine has run.

key.name: show-indicator
key.description: Show an icon and menu in the GNOME Shell top bar.

key.name: wake-enabled
key.description: Listen all the time for the wake word, and start a hands-free dictation when it is heard. The microphone stays open (the system shows it).

key.name: wake-phrase
key.description: The word or phrase to say; several, separated by commas.

key.name: wake-sensitivity
key.description: Higher hears the word more easily, and wakes by mistake more often.

key.name: wake-on-battery
key.description: Keep listening for the wake word on battery.

key.name: sounds
key.description: A short sound when listening starts and when the text is written (follows the system's event sounds setting).

key.name: pause-media
key.description: Pause the media players that are playing (MPRIS) when a dictation starts, and resume them afterwards.

key.name: paste-last-shortcut
key.description: Shortcut that writes the last dictation again where the cursor is. Empty: none.

key.name: show-hud
key.description: Show the microphone level and live text while dictating.

key.name: hud-position
key.description: bottom: a pill floating at the bottom of the screen, above the dock. island: a capsule that slides out of the top bar, always in the same place. cursor: next to the text cursor (the pointer when the application does not report one).

key.name: hud-effect
key.description: How the pill appears and disappears (at the bottom of the screen it always rises; glow adds its halo there). swell: a bump swells out of the bar. drop: a drop falls from the bar and springs open. spring: the capsule zooms out of the bar and wobbles. glow: swell with a halo.

key.name: hud-preview
key.description: Changed by the preferences to make the extension show the pill once, to preview its animation.

key.name: commands-enabled
key.description: Optional: a second shortcut to say what to do (open an application, change a setting, run a shell command after confirmation). Needs the command helper of the speech engine.

key.name: command-shortcut
key.description: Hold it and say what to do; tap it for hands-free listening. Only bound while commands-enabled is on.

key.name: command-llm
key.summary: Use the local LLM for commands
key.description: Send the requests the rules do not understand (shell commands, questions) to the language model that the command helper runs on this computer. Off: only the built-in GNOME actions.

key.name: command-work-dir
key.description: Where confirmed commands run. Empty = the home folder.

key.name: command-speak
key.description: Say the result of a command aloud with the engine's voice (installed by: voice-hold-engine setup --tts). A command's output is summarised by the local LLM first.

key.name: command-voice
key.description: fr or en. Empty: follows the session language.
